mapper.select: select * from SYS_BATCH_UNISTART t where STATUS = 'UNR'
select * from SYS_BATCH_UNISTART t where STATUS = 'UNR' OR STATUS = 'RUN'
mapper.update: update SYS_BATCH_UNISTART set STATUS= 'BRK' WHERE 1 = 1 AND (STATUS = 'UNR' OR STATUS = 'RUN')
update SYS_BATCH_UNISTART_DETAIL set STATUS= 'BRK' WHERE 1 = 1 AND (STATUS = 'UNR' OR STATUS = 'RUN')
mapper.select: SELECT A.SEQ_NO, A.STATUS AS TASK_STATUS FROM SYS_BATCHGRP_EXEC_INFO A WHERE A.OTHER_PARAM3 = #{detailSeqNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT A.SEQ_NO, B.TASK_STATUS FROM SYS_BATCHGRP_EXEC_INFO A INNER JOIN SYS_BATCH_EXEC_INFO B ON A.SEQ_NO = B.BATCH_EXEDETAIL_SEQ_NO WHERE A.OTHER_PARAM3 = #{detailSeqNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY A.SEQ_NO, B.TASK_STATUS
select BATCH_SEQ_NO, TASK_ID from SYS_BATCH_JOB WHERE 1 = 1 AND BATCH_SEQ_NO = #{batchSeqNos,jdbcType = VARCHAR}
select * from SYS_BATCH_UNISTART_GRPCONFIG t where t.CONFIG_ID = #{configId,jdbcType = VARCHAR} order by t.ORDER_NO
SELECT SEQ_NO seqNo FROM SYS_PREBATCH_RESULT where task_status = 'ERROR' AND STOP_FLAG = '01' AND DETAIL_COUNT > 0 AND check_date = #{checkDate,jdbcType=DATE}
